title: TITAN-VIBE: Virtual Intact Block Extraction for periodic reconstruction
description: TITAN-VIBE 1.2.0: TITAN-VIBE is built from a VIBE-only TITAN source tree (the structure, index, topology and trajectory readers, VIBE and the PDB writer; the executable titan-vibe accepts only these options) on Windows and on Linux. Reconstruction is faster and its outputs are the same as in 1.1.0. Includes a Windows x86-64 executable, the source with build instructions for Windows and Linux, quick-start examples, the 480 held-out inputs with reference outputs, and replay drivers with the validation records of this release.
